question: I forgot to cancel my Amazon Prime free trial and got charged. Can I get that money back?
reference_answer: AmazonHelp said that if you haven't used any Prime benefits since the charge you get a full refund; otherwise the refund is pro-rated. They linked the help page for cancelling the membership.

question: Our Amazon merchant account was suspended. Who are sellers supposed to contact?
reference_answer: AmazonHelp directed merchants to the Seller Support team through a help link rather than the consumer support account.

question: Quel est le numéro du service client d'Amazon en France ?
reference_answer: AmazonHelp confirmed 0 805 10 14 20 as the Amazon France customer service number.

question: Since the latest iOS update my iPhone keeps replacing the letter 'i' with a strange symbol. Is Apple fixing this?
reference_answer: AppleSupport said it would be fixed in a future software update and shared a workaround article (a text replacement) to use until then. The customer said the workaround didn't help and AppleSupport moved to DM.

question: After updating to iOS 11 the Phone app on my iPhone only shows a blank screen. What should I try?
reference_answer: AppleSupport suggested force-closing the Phone app, restarting the iPhone and opening it again. When that didn't work they asked whether it started with the update and recommended making a current iCloud or iTunes backup before further steps.

question: If I schedule an Uber ride in advance, am I guaranteed a driver?
reference_answer: No. Uber_Support said scheduling doesn't guarantee a driver; if none can be found you're notified at the end of your selected 15-minute window.

question: How do I complain about a rude Uber Eats delivery person?
reference_answer: Uber_Support said to tap the 'Help' button in the app; if you've already done that, DM them your account email so they can follow up.

question: Why couldn't I get the free Krispy Kreme dozen on Uber Eats?
reference_answer: Uber_Support said a technical issue caused by high demand was affecting orders, and later that demand was so high the free Original Glazed dozens ran out. They said to watch for future promotions.

question: My friend left her phone in an Uber and can't log in to her account. Can I contact the driver for her?
reference_answer: Uber_Support said that due to its privacy policy it must speak directly to the account holder, who should contact Uber through the help link or DM the email address on the account.

question: Spotify put an album by a different artist with the same name on my favourite band's page. How do I report it?
reference_answer: SpotifyCares asked for the album's Spotify URI (right-click the album > Share > URI) so they could correct the artist page.

question: On Spotify Free on my Android phone I can't pick a specific song, it just shuffles. Is that a bug?
reference_answer: No. SpotifyCares explained that on the Free tier you can't stream specific songs on demand on mobile; Free is ad-supported and shuffle-only on mobile devices.

question: The Spotify web player has been stuck playing one song silently for hours. How do I fix it?
reference_answer: SpotifyCares suggested clearing the browser's cache and cookies or trying an incognito window. The customer found refreshing the tab fixed it.

question: How do I hide the Find Friends panel in the Spotify app on my Mac?
reference_answer: Click View and uncheck Right Sidebar.

question: Songs I listen to every day suddenly disappeared from Spotify and my playlist. Why?
reference_answer: SpotifyCares said content is sometimes temporarily removed because of licensing changes and hopefully will be available again soon.

question: Spotify's Your Time Capsule keeps showing an error message even though I listen every day. What's wrong?
reference_answer: SpotifyCares said to keep listening to songs you love and make sure you're not in a Private Session, giving Spotify time to learn your taste.

question: Delta still hasn't found my delayed bag. Can I get reimbursed for things I buy in the meantime?
reference_answer: Yes. Delta said you can use the delayed-bag file you created to be reimbursed for purchases made while waiting for the bag.

question: My Delta account got locked after too many failed login attempts. How do I get back in?
reference_answer: Delta said the account stays locked for 24 hours after the last failed attempt; after that you can try again, but more wrong attempts will lock it again.

question: My suitcase came off a Delta flight ripped to shreds. How do I file a claim?
reference_answer: Delta sent a claim form (completing it gives you a file reference number). When the form wouldn't submit, they said to call Baggage Service at 1-800-325-8224, open 24/7, to file the claim.

question: Miles from one leg of my Delta trip vanished from my SkyMiles account. What can I do?
reference_answer: Delta agents resubmitted the flight for credit and sent a review request to the SkyMiles team, promising an update.

question: How do I file a discrimination complaint with Delta about how a passenger was treated?
reference_answer: Delta said it does not condone discrimination and pointed to an online complaint form handled by its discrimination specialists.

question: I booked an American Airlines flight with miles and need to cancel. Why am I being charged a fee?
reference_answer: American charges a fee to reinstate miles into your account (the customer was charged $175).

question: American rebooked me because I'll miss my connection at DFW. Will my checked bag follow me to the new flight?
reference_answer: American said the bag was loaded and should transfer with you, and that you can track its location through their bag-tracking link.

question: American Airlines moved me out of the Main Cabin Extra seat I paid for. Do I get a refund?
reference_answer: American said it sometimes has to make last-minute seat changes and would refund the Main Cabin Extra charge after travel is complete.

question: Can T-Mobile alert me when I've used half of my monthly data?
reference_answer: TMobileHelp suggested tracking data usage in the T-Mobile app and offered help by DM. They did not mention a 50% alert; the customer only got alerts at 80% usage.

question: My Comcast cable box died. Can I just swap it at an Xfinity store?
reference_answer: Yes. comcastcares said you can swap it out at the service center.

question: Was the recent Comcast internet outage caused by Level 3?
reference_answer: comcastcares said there was a known issue with Level 3 earlier that caused problems and that it had been resolved.

question: Why can't I watch the OSU vs Wisconsin game on my phone with Comcast?
reference_answer: comcastcares said that due to licensing agreements the game wasn't available on mobile devices.

question: Southwest cancelled my flight and the website won't let me rebook. Will changing it cost me anything?
reference_answer: SouthwestAir said they could rebook the customer at no charge and asked for the confirmation number by DM.

question: My Southwest flight to Las Vegas is delayed but a later flight to the same city is boarding first. Why?
reference_answer: SouthwestAir said the delay was due to air traffic control (ATC) directives and that departure times are based on those directives.

question: Does Southwest notify you when fares drop on a route you're watching?
reference_answer: No. SouthwestAir said it has no fare-decrease notifications, but you can sign up for Click 'N Save emails for alerts on its best deals.

question: Why doesn't the NBC Sports app work with my Spectrum account on Fire Stick?
reference_answer: Ask_Spectrum said this is due to distribution agreements between Spectrum and NBC Sports.

question: Tesco asked for the SC code on a product so they can refund me. What is it and where do I find it?
reference_answer: It's the supplier code. One agent said it begins 'SC' and is near the barcode; another described it as a 4-6 digit number next to Tesco's address.

question: I bought a faulty product at Tesco but can't take it back to the store. Can I still get a refund?
reference_answer: Yes. Tesco can refund from Twitter: DM your name, address and email plus product details (barcode, supplier code, store), choose a refund by email or post, and they may pass your details to the supplier.

question: British Airways lost my suitcase on my flight to New York. Can I claim for essentials I have to buy?
reference_answer: Yes. BA said to check the delayed bag's status through its link and send receipts for essentials bought while without your bags so they can arrange reimbursement.

question: Why does British Airways sell more tickets than there are seats on a flight?
reference_answer: BA said overselling is common airline practice that keeps fares low; when a flight is oversold they ask for volunteers to travel later and, if nobody volunteers, select passengers.

question: I tried to check in for my British Airways flight too many times and now I'm blocked. What do I do?
reference_answer: BA said you can try again 24 hours after the block; it's a security measure so nobody else can access your booking.

question: Why was British Airways flight BA2278 from Oakland cancelled on 18 November?
reference_answer: BA said it was cancelled because of a technical issue with the aircraft.

question: My Virgin Trains service was late and I couldn't sit in my reserved seat. Can I claim compensation?
reference_answer: Yes. VirginTrains said you can claim compensation online through their link.

question: My phone with my Virgin Trains mobile tickets might be dead by the time I travel. What can I do?
reference_answer: VirginTrains said you must be able to display mobile tickets on your device, and suggested contacting the Aftersales team to see if they could be sent to another device.

question: I paid for Wi-Fi on a Virgin Trains train and it doesn't work. What should I do?
reference_answer: VirginTrains suggested forgetting the network in your device settings, reconnecting, and following their link.

question: UPS says my package will arrive by 'end of day'. What time does that mean?
reference_answer: UPSHelp said end of day is 7 PM (delivery times run 9am to 7pm), though drivers can be out later in some areas.

question: Is there a way to get a more precise UPS delivery time than just 'out for delivery'?
reference_answer: UPSHelp recommended a free UPS My Choice account: set preferences, get updates, choose a two- or four-hour delivery window, and in some areas use Follow My Package.

question: I need to reschedule my UPS new-hire orientation but the phone number on my paperwork doesn't work. What should I do?
reference_answer: UPSHelp said to sign in to the UPS jobs website and reschedule there, and if that doesn't work, go to the building and talk to HR directly.

question: UPS tracking says my package was transferred to the post office. When will it arrive?
reference_answer: UPSHelp said the post office will deliver it within 1-2 days.

question: My UPS shipment to Kuwait is stuck in customs. Can UPS do anything?
reference_answer: UPSHelp said customs clearance is out of UPS's control; the shipper had been contacted to provide documentation and you need to contact the shipper for updates.

question: Hulu Live TV keeps skipping on my Chromecast. How do I fix it?
reference_answer: hulu_support suggested rebooting the device and modem/router (power cycling the equipment), following their troubleshooting link, and checking that internet speeds meet Hulu's requirements.

question: Hulu shows error runtime-2 on my PS4 after a few minutes of playback. What should I do?
reference_answer: hulu_support suggested restarting the device and following their troubleshooting link. The customer found the problem was limited to one season of a show.

question: Why does Hulu play so many commercials during some shows?
reference_answer: hulu_support said ad breaks typically happen in the same time slots as in the original broadcast.

question: Why does Chipotle's queso taste so different from other queso?
reference_answer: Chipotle said it's made with real, unprocessed ingredients and that they're still working to perfect the recipe.

question: Which Chipotle restaurants still have soft corn tortillas?
reference_answer: Chipotle said it is phasing out soft corn tortillas entirely.

question: Can I order Chipotle guacamole without onions?
reference_answer: No, not at the moment.

question: My coworkers got a free chips and guac offer in the Chipotle app but I didn't. Why?
reference_answer: ChipotleTweets asked whether the app update had been downloaded and pointed to a contact form so they could check on the offer.

question: I got Hulu through my Sprint Unlimited plan. Will I be charged when the trial ends?
reference_answer: No. sprintcare said Hulu comes with Sprint Unlimited plans at no extra charge; it isn't a free trial.

question: Forza Motorsport 7 goes to a black screen after the driver selection cutscene on my Xbox. Is there a fix?
reference_answer: XboxSupport suggested closing and reopening the game, then removing and re-adding the profile, and finally said it was a known issue being investigated by the relevant teams.

question: The Crunchyroll app on my Xbox One keeps closing by itself. What should I try?
reference_answer: Uninstall the app, power cycle the Xbox One and the router/modem, then reinstall. If it continues, XboxSupport asked for Detailed Network Statistics (Settings > Network > Network Settings > Detailed Network Statistics).

question: My FIFA 18 disc won't load on Xbox even though I have the full game. What do I do?
reference_answer: Delete FIFA 18, power cycle the console, then reinstall the game.

question: I keep getting disconnected at the end of Call of Duty WWII matches on Xbox and lose my XP. Is it my connection?
reference_answer: XboxSupport said it appeared to be a known issue that Activision was investigating, and offered to help troubleshoot the network connection too.

question: My Xbox One S makes a chirping noise while I play. Is that normal and can I get it repaired?
reference_answer: XboxSupport said the console makes some noise when the fan is running; if you're concerned, set it up for service online, and a service charge applies if it's out of warranty.

question: My PS4 keeps showing a network error when I connect to PlayStation Network. What should I try first?
reference_answer: AskPlayStation suggested power cycling your network devices; if the error persists, start the PS4 in Safe Mode and choose Restore Default Settings.

question: A PS4 trophy I earned won't unlock even after reinstalling the game. What can I do?
reference_answer: AskPlayStation suggested using Restore Licenses to refresh your purchases.

question: My internet is fast but my PS4 gets poor upload speeds even on a wired connection. Any fix?
reference_answer: After the general network tips, AskPlayStation suggested Safe Mode option 4 (Restore Default Settings) and then setting up the connection again.

question: After I signed in on a friend's PS4, my games show a content lock on my own console. How do I fix it?
reference_answer: AskPlayStation said the console has to be set as your primary PS4 to access the content, and to Restore Licenses and try again.

question: I spent a prestige token on the wrong weapon in Call of Duty WWII. Can Activision refund it?
reference_answer: No. ATVIAssist said prestige tokens can't be refunded.

question: Call of Duty keeps saying 'game restarted for a new update' and won't start. Any ideas?
reference_answer: ATVIAssist suggested power cycling the console and resetting the router for 5 minutes. The customer fixed it by deleting and reinstalling the game.

question: When will my Target pre-order ship?
reference_answer: AskTarget said pre-orders ship on or near the release date, as stated on the item page, and to watch your email for updates.

question: How do I get the passenger charter discount when renewing my GWR season ticket?
reference_answer: GWRHelp said that if the season ticket was bought at a station you renew at the same ticket office; if it was bought online you renew online and then email them to claim the discount.

question: Does GWR offer information or announcements in Welsh?
reference_answer: GWRHelp said Welsh literature is available on request and some staff may make announcements in Welsh.

question: My GWR train was cancelled because of a crew shortage. Can I get compensation?
reference_answer: GWRHelp said compensation may be due depending on the delay, claimed through their link.

question: No GWR trains from Kemble to Paddington show up for 2 December. Will anything be running?
reference_answer: GWRHelp said an amended timetable for upgrade work wasn't finalised yet (expected within a couple of weeks); there would be a train service but possibly longer journey times or replacement buses for part of the journey.

question: I bought a product at Sainsbury's that turned out to be bad. How do I get a refund?
reference_answer: Sainsbury's either asks you to take it back to the store with your receipt for an exchange or refund, or asks which store it was from (and sometimes for a barcode photo) and then for your Nectar card number by DM so they can add the refund, sometimes with extra, as points.

question: My Sainsbury's online order came with a poor substitute. What are my options?
reference_answer: sainsburys said the store sends the closest available match to what you ordered and you can send it back if you're unhappy with it.

question: Sainsbury's stopped selling a product I really like. Can I ask them to bring it back?
reference_answer: They confirmed the product is no longer stocked and said you can log a product request through their link.

question: How do I report a Lyft driver who was driving dangerously?
reference_answer: AskLyft pointed to its Critical Response Line (click 'Call Me' and enter your number on their page) and said you can also report it through the Help Center.

question: How much will a Lyft from Phoenix airport cost, and what if I have a lot of luggage?
reference_answer: AskLyft said prices vary by area and to use the price estimator on your city's page; they suggested requesting a Lyft Plus for extra luggage room.

question: What does Lyft do about riders who are racist?
reference_answer: AskLyft said it has a very strict anti-discrimination policy, takes these reports seriously, and asked for details by DM to investigate.

question: I've already used most of my O2 data a week into the month. How can I work out why?
reference_answer: O2 suggested checking your remaining balance on My O2, whether Wi-Fi Assist is turned on, and which apps use the most data.

question: I upgraded my O2 contract and should get extra loyalty data, but it isn't showing in My O2. Why?
reference_answer: O2 said it is added automatically once the 14-day cooling-off period has passed.

question: Can O2 add a family discount to my existing contracts?
reference_answer: O2 said the family plan discount can only be added at renewal.

question: My O2 Priority code for the Star Wars phone case isn't taking any money off at checkout. Why?
reference_answer: O2 said the codes ran out very quickly because the offer was so popular.

question: I received a phishing email pretending to be from PayPal. Where should I send it?
reference_answer: AskPayPal asked for the email to be forwarded to its phishing-report address (redacted in the dataset as __email__) and asked the customer to delete the screenshot they had posted.

question: PayPal took money from my bank account instead of the payment method I chose. Why?
reference_answer: AskPayPal said the funds may not have been available in your preferred payment method to complete the payment.

question: How can I get an old M-Pesa statement?
reference_answer: Statements for the last 12 months are available via *234#; for older periods visit a Safaricom shop with your original ID for a printout at KSh 25 per page. Another agent said statements can't be sent to your phone and that the last 6 months are available by registering or logging in online.

question: How do I stop Safaricom promotional text messages?
reference_answer: Dial *100# or *200#, choose Products and Services, then option 98 'Stop Safaricom Promotion SMS', and follow the prompts.

question: How do I change the Wi-Fi name and password on my Safaricom fibre router?
reference_answer: Safaricom_Care said to log in at 192.168.100.1 (user root, password admin) and change it under settings. The customer got in using the password printed on the router.

question: Someone called saying they're from Safaricom and asked about my M-Pesa. How can I tell if it's really them?
reference_answer: Safaricom only contacts customers from 0722000000 (or 0729333333 during promotions). Don't share personal details with other numbers; report fraud by SMS to 333, free of charge.

question: My Verizon Fios internet is down and the router still shows a red light after a reboot. What next?
reference_answer: VerizonSupport said to reboot the battery backup unit (BBU) by holding the Alarm Silence or Reset button for 15 seconds; it may beep and take a few minutes to reinitialize, so check the router after about 3 minutes.

question: My Verizon Wi-Fi keeps dropping during online games. What can I do?
reference_answer: VerizonSupport said it may be wireless interference and suggested rebooting the router so it moves to another channel, then testing again.

question: Is McDonald's bringing back Szechuan sauce?
reference_answer: McDonald's said it isn't coming back for good, but would return for a third round in more US locations that winter; participating restaurants were listed through their link.

question: Are Marks & Spencer's pumpkin Percy Pigs vegan?
reference_answer: No. M&S said they're suitable for vegetarians but not vegans (the customer pointed to beeswax).

question: The item I want is only in stock at another Marks & Spencer store. Can they send it to my local store or post it?
reference_answer: No. M&S said they can't transfer stock between stores or post from other branches; you'd have to go to that store (calling ahead to have it put aside), or order online for delivery to a store if it's in stock online.

question: How do I reset my Netflix password if I can't access my email anymore?
reference_answer: Not covered: Netflix support isn't in the corpus. The assistant should say it has no Netflix support history.

question: Will FedEx leave my package with a neighbour if I'm not home?
reference_answer: Not covered: FedEx isn't in the corpus. The assistant must not substitute UPS's delivery policies.

question: Does Starbucks give me a free drink on my birthday through the rewards app?
reference_answer: Not covered: Starbucks isn't in the corpus.

question: How do I move my Instagram account to a new phone number?
reference_answer: Not covered: Instagram support isn't in the corpus.

question: Can I take my small dog in the cabin on a Ryanair flight?
reference_answer: Not covered: Ryanair isn't in the corpus. The assistant must not substitute other airlines' pet policies.

question: How do I cancel my Disney+ subscription?
reference_answer: Not covered: Disney+ launched in 2019, after this 2017 dataset.

question: What is the battery capacity of the iPhone 15?
reference_answer: Not covered: the iPhone 15 postdates the 2017 dataset. The assistant must not answer with older iPhone battery information.

question: How much does Sony charge to repair a PS5 DualSense controller?
reference_answer: Not covered: the PS5 postdates the 2017 dataset. The assistant must not substitute PS4 repair information.

question: Does Tesla include free Supercharging with the Model 3?
reference_answer: Not covered: Tesla isn't in the corpus.

question: What is the time limit on free Zoom meetings?
reference_answer: Not covered: Zoom isn't in the corpus.
